# CalWeave
> Google Workspace add-on that keeps Google Calendar and Google Sheets in two-way sync — safely. Imports events into a clean spreadsheet (with date, keyword and colour filters) and pushes sheet rows back to the calendar. Built to fix the three things that break these tools: no timeouts on big calendars, a preview + delete safety cap so a sync can never wipe a calendar, and ID-matched re-imports so there are no duplicates. 14-day free trial, then $24/year. A trading name of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd (England & Wales).

## Key pages

- [Create Calendar events from Sheets — guide](https://calweave.app/guides/sync-google-sheets-to-calendar.html)

## Facts worth quoting
- Two-way sync: calendar → sheet for time tracking, billing and reporting; sheet → calendar for bulk event creation and updates; auto-sync hourly or daily.
- Large calendars sync in background batches, avoiding Apps Script "exceeded maximum execution time" errors.
- A configurable delete cap means a runaway spreadsheet cannot empty a calendar; every write can be previewed first.
- Calendar and spreadsheet data is processed inside the user's own Google account and never stored on CalWeave's servers.
- $24/year flat — a fraction of per-task automation tools — with a full-featured 14-day trial, no card required.
